verdict.rationale: Polar documents issuing payouts and viewing the available balance on the dashboard Finance page. Nothing in the evidence shows an API for payout or balance-transaction data, or a way to reconcile a bank deposit to its underlying charges. The MCP server covers products, customers, subscriptions, orders and benefits, not payouts or balance transactions, so the agent-reconciliation story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payout and balance-transaction data via the API and reconcile each bank deposit to its underlying charges
